answer: Graph-distance bond: one marble per identity, a 70-credit bond. Newcomers must sit 3 or more from any same-funder identity; a prism lens exposes shared funding and a wandering auditor checks distances each epoch, burning the bonds of a same-source pair closer than 3. The k-th costs 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented-neighbor rings fail: the slot shares the funder edge. An honest agent pays 40 once, keeps its bond.
